selection.name: betterleaks (C02)
selection.role: Provisional local exposure detector: scan the working tree and Git history before publication. Agents can invoke its CLI.
selection.install_source: The v1.9.0 README documents this Go installation path with @latest; the command pins the inspected release.

basis.shows: Documents Git, filesystem and stdin scanning, contextual filtering, credential validation and installation. These capabilities support selection; they do not establish measured superiority.
Released 2026-09-29, within 90 days; distributes Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 binaries.
Default-branch commit dated 2026-09-30; repository is not archived. This later commit adds pre-receive functionality, which is not attributed to the pinned release.
Publishes detection, validation, filtering, source and reporting tests, fixtures, and pre-commit integration files.
Ubuntu and Windows test jobs succeeded on the inspected default-branch commit. These are correctness checks, not comparative detection benchmarks.
A detection-rule contribution was opened and updated on 2026-10-02, providing additional maintenance-activity evidence.

selection.name: ggshield (C01)
selection.role: Conditional complementary Claude Code/Codex interaction guard. Qualify its hooks on the target host before relying on containment; authentication, network access and service quota are required.
selection.install_source: Upstream README installation command; inspected release v1.55.0 and README at commit 841a768aa3255144b5cd2f518b21a1511a265eef.

basis.shows: Documents Claude Code and Codex hooks installed through ggshield install, interaction blocking, Git hooks, pipx installation and authentication. Detection uses GitGuardian's API.
Released 2026-09-24; documents assistant-output blocking and supplies Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 packages.

Default-branch commit dated 2026-10-01 addresses Claude Code echoing blocked prompts. This warrants release-versus-commit containment testing; the title alone does not establish which released versions are affected.
Official search excerpt confirms a free plan exists and identifies the detection backend as proprietary. The CLI repository is open source; its backend is not.

not_selected.name: gitleaks
not_selected.reason: Strong close alternative with documented pre-commit setup and successful Ubuntu/Windows tests; its 2026-07-22 default-branch commit passes the maintenance cutoff, but its latest release is 2026-03-21, and no verified accuracy advantage offsets Betterleaks' broader documented capabilities. [README](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/blob/v8.30.1/README.md), [commit](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/commit/b58d3f102cf3a2c84cb7f923d05c25c9b1aed84b), [release](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/tag/v8.30.1), [tests](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/actions/runs/29939776129).

not_selected.name: trufflehog
not_selected.reason: Current and capable: release v3.97.9 is dated 2026-09-24 and its default-branch commit 2026-10-01; active verification and broad source scanning overlap the selected detector, without verified incremental coverage for this checkout requirement. The packet's null repository was provisionally resolved to TruffleSecurity's project. [README](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/blob/v3.97.9/README.md), [release](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/releases/tag/v3.97.9), [commit](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/commit/e28360875917c9c730f9c64aae29fb93aa6c359e).

not_selected.name: OpenBao
not_selected.reason: Provides relevant encrypted storage and credential lifecycle management, and both release v2.7.1 and its default-branch commit are dated 2026-10-01; the packet establishes no concrete shared-secret or multi-operator need that qualifies operating it. [README](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/blob/a4f7e569875f836f246bf9e41aff984741a9693e/README.md), [release](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/releases/tag/v2.7.1), [commit](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/commit/a4f7e569875f836f246bf9e41aff984741a9693e).

excluded.name: noseyparker
excluded.fact: GitHub reports archived=true. Its latest default-branch commit, dated 2026-02-21, announces retirement and also falls outside 90 days. [Repository API](https://api.github.com/repos/praetorian-inc/noseyparker), [commit](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/noseyparker/commit/2e6e7f36ce36619852532bbe698d8cb7a26d2da7).

layers.deciding_comparison: The local detector choice remains provisional. Compare Betterleaks v1.9.0 against Gitleaks v8.30.1 on WSL2 using the same labelled working-tree, staged-change and history corpus: provider credentials, generic secrets, encoded values and realistic negatives. Measure recall, precision, missed publication events, blocking exit behavior, latency and peak RAM. Separately qualify ggshield v1.55.0 against its inspected later commit with synthetic secrets in Claude Code/Codex prompts, tool arguments and outputs; inspect blocking and transcript echoes. OpenBao qualification requires a concrete sharing need first. Broker credential handling remains a trading gate.
evidence_gaps: No controlled cross-candidate benchmark was verified; the packet contains no recorded all-arm comparison. Successful CI does not establish superior detection accuracy.
The selected tools detect or block exposure; they do not establish a complete off-checkout storage arrangement for general sign-ins and broker credentials.
Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 distributions were verified. WSL2 execution, clean installation and agent-hook behavior were not tested; this requirement does not require GPU acceleration.
ggshield's current CI conclusions were not retrieved. Complete release-level prompt/output containment remains unqualified.

Conflicting official excerpts describe different free-tier quotas. Specialist review accepted only the shared conclusion that a free plan exists; no numeric entitlement or mandatory-payment claim is made.
Issue responsiveness was not established across all candidates. Recent commits, releases and contributions show activity, not response quality.

The requested ctx_fetch_and_index call was blocked because it requires approval and this session's policy is never. READMEs were instead retrieved through the GitHub API, indexed with ctx_index and read with ctx_search. Pricing evidence is limited to official search excerpts.
